name: Licensing Supervisor
description: Module 1 - Supervise licensing officers and analysts; oversee queue.

name: F&P Assessor
description: Module 2 - Initiate F&P, manage screening, record adverse findings, run AI analysis, issue determinations, manage conditions and monitoring.

name: Regulated Entity User
description: Licensed entity user — licensing, returns, complaints and F&P.

name: Consumer / Complainant
description: Public Complaint Portal only - Submit complaints, receive acknowledgements, check status by reference.

name: Licensing Analyst
description: Module 1 - Analyze licensing applications and provide recommendations.

name: Applicant
description: External applicant — can submit licence applications and respond to RFIs.

name: Legacy Admin
description: Backfilled full-access role for pre-RBAC admins

name: Investigator
description: Module 4 (Investigation) - Access restricted investigation workspace, manage evidence repository, conduct interviews, prepare investigation reports.

name: Approver / Decision-Maker
description: Modules 1, 2 - View consolidated cases, approve/conditionally approve/reject, issue digitally signed licenses, override AI recommendations, sign enforcement orders.

name: Security Administrator
description: Users, roles, permissions, security and security audit.

name: Regulatory Data Administrator
description: Regulatory Data Model, classifications, identifier types and reporting metadata.

name: Integration Administrator
description: Integration Manager, connections, health and provider configuration.

name: Entity Resolution Supervisor
description: Approves resolution decisions and controlled entity merges.

name: Conduct Analyst
description: Market conduct analysis and complaint investigation.

name: Auditor
description: Read-only assurance access across regulatory records.

name: Super Admin
description: Full system access with all permissions

name: Complaints Officer
description: Intake, triage and investigation of consumer complaints.

name: Complaints Supervisor
description: Approves complaint RFIs, escalations and closures.

name: Legal Counsel
description: Legal review of licensing, enforcement and appeal matters.

name: AML/CFT Supervision Officer
description: AML/CFT risk assessment and confidential findings.

name: Appeals Panel Member
description: Independent determination of licensing and F&P appeals.

name: Payment Systems Supervisor
description: Module 3 (Payment Systems) - Supervise FMIs and retail payment operators, conduct PFMI assessments, oversee MSBs, manage payment workflows.

name: Inspection Supervisor
description: Plans examinations and signs off workpapers.

name: Workflow Administrator
description: Designs and publishes approval workflows and SLAs.

name: Rule Engine Administrator
description: Authors, tests and activates supervisory rules.

name: Notification Administrator
description: Owns notification templates, events and channels.

name: Licensee Primary User
description: Submits returns, applications and filings for the licensee.

name: Licensee Secondary User
description: Prepares filings but cannot submit them.

name: Entity Primary Point of Contact
description: Manages entity users and confirms entity data.
